pages.purpose: The AI Team's intro while it is off: a drawing of a task going from agent to agent, what the team does in four steps (plans, works, checks, merges), what it needs on this kind of server, and one primary action that hands over to that kind's own set-up (docs/qa/team-discover-2026-09-25).

the server kind (teamServerKindOf): OpenCode inside the app, OpenCode in Termux (the phone's runtime supportsAiTeam decides between set-up and 'cannot run it'), or a computer (TeamDiscovery probes the host)

elements.label: Set it up
elements.effect: The one primary. OpenCode inside the app: pushReplacement(PluginsSettingsScreen), where BuiltinTeamSection adds, turns on and starts the team. Termux: reopens the phone offer (PhoneOffer.open) and pushReplacementNamed('/termux-setup'), whose TeamPhoneOnboardingBlock installs it. A computer without Gas City found: showTeamHostGuideSheet, then looks again when it closes.
gates: in-app: always; Termux: supportsAiTeam; a computer: TeamDiscovery found nothing (yet)

pages.title: Board
pages.purpose: The AI Team's board (docs/design/team-board-2026-09-26.md): a project's tasks in five columns (Backlog/Ready/Working/Review/Done), one page at a time; a card opens its conversation (or its Work sheet when it belongs to no task), its ⋯ or a long press opens the move sheet.

elements.label: Choose project
elements.effect: _ProjectSwitcher: PopupMenuButton opener; opens the project menu (shown only when the host reports more than one project).

elements.label: <project name>
elements.effect: _ProjectSwitcher.onSelect(id): setState(() => _project = id); clears pending moves and their hold timers.

elements.label: Backlog | Ready | Working | Review | Done
elements.effect: TeamBoardTabs.onSelect -> _select(column): setState(() => _column = column) then pages.animateToPage (jumpToPage when motion is reduced).

elements.label: Add to backlog
elements.effect: _add(): showTeamBoardAddSheet(context); on a non-empty answer calls edits.addToBacklog(title, projectId) and selects the Backlog column.

elements.label: Dismiss
elements.effect: KitNotice.onDismiss -> setState(() => _failure = null): clears the move-failed notice (team-board-failure).
gates: a move was refused by the host (_failure != null)

elements.label: Try again
elements.effect: KitAction onPressed -> _refresh(): controller.retry() when failed, else controller.refresh().
gates: the first answer is overdue (GraceTimer, 8 s) while board == null

elements.label: Add to backlog
elements.effect: _add(): showTeamBoardAddSheet(context); same as team-board-add, offered once in the empty state instead of the app bar (design standard §6).

elements.label: <task title>
elements.effect: TeamBoardCardView.onOpen -> _open(card) -> openTeamBoardCard: opens the task's conversation (TeamConversation.open) when card.runId != null, else the card's Work sheet (showWorkSheet, work-sheet) for a card that belongs to no task.

elements.label: Move or change
elements.effect: TeamBoardCardView.onMoves -> _showMoves(card): showTeamBoardMoveSheet.
gates: edits.movesFor(card) is not empty (hidden when the host allows no moves for this card)

elements.label: [long press on a card]
elements.effect: GestureDetector.onLongPress -> _showMoves(card): showTeamBoardMoveSheet (same sheet as the card's ⋯ button; unconditional, even when onMoves is hidden, in which case the sheet only offers Open conversation/details and says why there are no moves).

pages.title: <task title>
pages.purpose: The moves available for one card (start now, back to backlog, change priority, reopen, cancel) plus Open conversation/Open details; no gesture moves a card by itself.

elements.label: Start now
elements.effect: row(TeamBoardMove.startNow) onTap: pops TeamBoardChoseMove(startNow); the board's _move() then calls edits.run(startNow, card) directly.

elements.label: Back to backlog
elements.effect: row(TeamBoardMove.backToBacklog) onTap: pops TeamBoardChoseMove(backToBacklog); the board's _move() then calls edits.run directly.

elements.label: Change priority
elements.effect: row(TeamBoardMove.priority) onTap: pops TeamBoardChoseMove(priority); the board's _move() then opens showTeamBoardPrioritySheet before calling edits.run(priority, card, priority: chosen).

elements.label: Reopen
elements.effect: row(TeamBoardMove.reopen) onTap: pops TeamBoardChoseMove(reopen); the board's _move() then calls edits.run directly.

elements.label: Open conversation | Open details
elements.effect: onTap: pops TeamBoardChoseOpen(); the board's _showMoves() then calls _open(card) -> openTeamBoardCard, same target as the card's own tap (team-board-card).

elements.label: Cancel task
elements.effect: row(TeamBoardMove.cancel) onTap (styled error, set apart with a divider): pops TeamBoardChoseMove(cancel); the board's _move() then calls confirmTeamBoardCancel before edits.run(cancel, card).

pages.title: Priority
pages.purpose: The priority choice for one card, current level checked.

elements.label: <priority>
elements.effect: KitRow onTap: pops the tapped priority (null when tapping the current one); the board's _move() then calls edits.run(TeamBoardMove.priority, card, priority: priority).

pages.title: Add to backlog
pages.purpose: "Add to backlog": one field, the task's own words.

elements.label: What should the team do?
elements.effect: TextField.onSubmitted -> _submit(): pops the trimmed text (Navigator.pop) when non-empty.

elements.label: Add to backlog
elements.effect: KitButton.onPressed -> _submit(): pops the trimmed text; disabled while the field is empty.

pages.title: Cancel “{title}”?
pages.purpose: Confirms before cancelling a backlog/ready task (§2: destructive, confirmed).

elements.label: Cancel task
elements.effect: Pops true; the board's _move() then calls edits.run(TeamBoardMove.cancel, card).

elements.label: Keep it
elements.effect: Navigator.pop(context, false); nothing changes.

pages.title: <task title>
pages.purpose: The AI Team task as a conversation (docs/design/team-conversation-2026-09-26.md): the task's prompt, the lead's narrated reply, the family strip of workers/reviewers, folded steps, gate cards, the merge section, and a composer that messages the worker (or planner) through the team's own message control.

elements.label: AI Team
elements.effect: _openTeamPage(): pushes TeamHomeScreen(controller: team).

elements.label: [opens overflow menu]
elements.effect: PopupMenuButton opener; onSelected fires for any item (there is one).

elements.label: Task details
elements.effect: Selecting 'Task details' -> onSelected -> _openDetails(run.id): pushes RunScreen(controller: team, runId: run.id).

elements.label: Earlier ({count})
elements.effect: _FoldLine.onTap: toggles expansion[_TeamLeadReply._storeKey], folding/unfolding the lead's earlier lines.

elements.label: <agent short name>
elements.effect: _TeamFamilyStrip chip onTap -> onOpen(agent) -> _openAgent(agent) -> openTeamAgentConversation: pushes ChatScreen(sessionID, watch: teamAgentWatch(...)) in watching mode, or AgentOutputScreen (team-agent-output) as Live output when the agent's own OpenCode session cannot be found on the connected server.

elements.label: <agent title>
elements.effect: _TeamAgentLine InkWell.onTap -> onOpen -> _openAgent(agent): same as the family strip's chip, shown again inline with the reply's own steps.

elements.label: Try again
elements.effect: KitAction onPressed: team.phase == failed ? team.retry() : team.refresh().
gates: the team is overdue (GraceTimer, 8 s) and not answering

elements.label: [Needs-you gate card]
elements.effect: TeamNeedsYouCard.onOpen -> showGateSheet(context, team, gate.id, now: widget.now); one card per open gate on this task.

elements.label: [Merge section]
elements.effect: Embeds TeamMergeSection(controller, run) (merge_section.dart, owned by i2); same widget as team-run-overview-merge-section.

elements.label: Message the team…
elements.effect: TeamComposerField onSend -> _send(recipient): team.messageAgent(recipient.id, text).

elements.label: Send
elements.effect: Same as the field's onSend: _send(recipient) -> team.messageAgent(recipient.id, text).

notPages.reason: TeamPolicyBlock is a read-only rendering block (supervision line + boundary chips) embedded in the run Overview (run_screen.dart:775) only when `controller.policy != null`; no surface and no interactive element.

Shared helper (design standard §3, §4), not a page: teamScreenState/teamScreenLoading/teamScreenFailed/teamStatusLine render the AI Team screens' connecting/error/stale states and one status line; its retry buttons are recorded as elements of the host pages (team-home, team-run, team-agent, team-agents) with `file` set here.

Embedded blocks, not pages of their own: TeamNeedsYouCard (one question as a request block) is shown on team-home-needs-you-tab (team_home_screen.dart:421) and team-run-overview-tab (run_screen.dart:780); TeamGateRow (one of several questions as a row) is shown on team-home-needs-you-tab (team_home_screen.dart:432). Both open the Gate sheet.

Embedded moments, no surface and no interactive element (motion slice D, 2026-09-25): TeamMergedCelebration heads team-run-overview-tab (run_screen.dart), the first time a merged task is seen, remembered per profile under oc.orchestration.{profileId}.celebrated; TeamNeedsYouLabel is the 'Needs you' heading on team-home and team-run-overview-tab, with an agent that waves once. Both drawings are decorative (excluded from semantics).

Drawings (KitScene, design standard §10), not pages: the AI Team's cast (board, planning, waking, merged, nudge, rest, idle) shown on team-home (no tasks, Needs you, the planning card, the host starting), team-run-overview-tab, team-agents (no agents), embedded-team-card (Nothing running) and the in-app and Termux AI Team sections while the team starts.

The routing API for the task conversation, not a page of its own: TeamConversation.open/start push TeamConversationScreen (team-conversation, chat/team_conversation_view.dart). TeamTaskConversationRow (the Overview's 'Open conversation' row) is recorded as team-run-overview-open-conversation on team-run-overview-tab; TeamAgentTranscript and TeamOpenConversationRow are re-exports of chat/team_conversation_view.dart (see team-conversation's own elements and team-agent-output).

notes: Area visibility: the whole AI Team area hangs off `ConnectionController.orchestration` (lib/state/connection.dart:712). `_syncOrchestration` (connection.dart:746-770) builds the OrchestrationController only when the connected `ServerProfile.orchestration` config is non-null and `!isIsolated`. Entry points: TeamCard in WorkspaceScreen (workspace_screen.dart:619-625 -> _openTeamHome:854), team deep links/notifications (lib/main.dart:877-903), ActivityScreen gate / blocked-agent tiles (activity_screen.dart:861, 926) and the gate sheet (gate_sheet.dart:79, 88).

Two different classes are both named TeamReceiptChip: lib/ui/widgets/team_receipt.dart:101 (gate rows, `onOpen`) and lib/ui/widgets/team_controls.dart:51 (control receipts, `onRetry`). team_home_screen.dart and activity_screen.dart import the former; run_screen.dart, agent_screen.dart and team_cycle_strip.dart the latter.

TeamHomeScreen.onOpenRun / onOpenAgent (team_home_screen.dart:58-61) can override row navigation, but the only production constructor (workspace_screen.dart:856) passes neither, so rows push RunScreen / AgentScreen.
team_cycle_strip.dart:345 shows a control TeamReceiptChip without onRetry (no button) while `receipt != null && !receipt.isSettled`; not interactive.
run_screen.dart _NeedsYouCard (1129) and agent_screen.dart _NeedsYou (key team-agent-gate, agent_screen.dart:325) are read-only: they say where to answer and have no tap target.

ProductErrorState 'Try again' / 'Report a bug' and ProductEmptyState's action button live in lib/ui/widgets/product_states.dart (area a-shell); recorded on the team pages with `file` set. openBugReport's target page is not resolved here.

Confirm sheets are rendered by showConfirmSheet (lib/ui/widgets/confirm_sheet.dart, area a-shell) via confirmTeamControl (team_controls.dart:275); the cancel label is always 'Keep going' (teamUiControlKeep); confirm buttons are destructive-styled.

TeamPlanningCard (start_run_sheet.dart:463), TeamMergeSection (merge_section.dart), WorkGraph (work_graph.dart), showWorkSheet, showGateSheet, showStartRunSheet and showTeamHostDetailsSheet belong to i2; referenced by targetWidget only. Target ids used: start-run-sheet, gate-sheet, work-sheet, team-host-details-sheet.
A TeamLinkKind.gate deep link goes to ActivityScreen(initialTeamGateId) (lib/main.dart:881-888), not to a team screen.

team-home, team-run and team-agent's error/loading states are recorded elsewhere in this file with `file: lib/ui/widgets/product_states.dart` (ProductErrorState/ProductEmptyState); their code now goes through team_states.dart's teamScreenState instead (see its docstring: "they now come from here"). Left as recorded (not this task's scope); team-agents, added after that refactor, is recorded against team_states.dart directly.

team-board (team_board_screen.dart), added with the board (docs/design/team-board-2026-09-26.md): its KitRefresh.onRefresh -> _refresh() on every column (team_board_screen.dart:640) and on the empty state (line 519) is left out of elements for the same reason as team-agents: no app-bar Refresh icon-button, so pulling to refresh may be the only way to force a refresh outside of the not-answering state (which has 'Try again', team-board-retry).
